# Uni Deals

> The dedicated student discounts, perks, and campus events platform for university and higher education students in Sri Lanka: https://www.unideals.co

## What is Uni Deals?

Uni Deals (https://www.unideals.co) connects verified Sri Lankan tertiary students with exclusive savings and lifestyle perks across food & dining, tech, fashion, wellness, fitness, and entertainment.

### How Student Verification Works
- **Eligibility:** Active university, campus, vocational, and school students in Sri Lanka.
- **Validity:** Verification status is active for 12 months from approval and renewable each academic year.
- **Tier 1 (Instant Email Verification):** Students with institutional email addresses (including `.ac.lk`, `.edu`, and campus domains like SLIIT, NSBM, IIT, KDU, University of Colombo, University of Moratuwa, University of Peradeniya, University of Kelaniya, CINEC, NIBM, APIIT) enter a one-time verification code sent to their campus inbox.
- **Tier 2 (Manual Student ID Verification):** Students with personal emails (e.g. Gmail) or attending schools/institutes without student email domains upload a clear photo of their student ID card for admin review (typically verified within 24–48 hours).

### How Deal Redemption Works
- **Online Deals:** Verified students click "Get Code" to reveal and copy an exclusive promo code for use on the partner brand's e-commerce store.
- **In-Store Deals:** Verified students generate a live, timed redemption pass on their smartphone to show the cashier or store manager at retail partner locations.

### Categories Available
- Food & Drink (cafes, restaurants, bakeries, beverage outlets)
- Tech & Mobile (electronics, gadgets, phone repairs, accessories, software)
- Fashion & Apparel (clothing, footwear, accessories)
- Learning & Education (courseware, tutoring, books, stationery)
- Beauty & Personal Care (skincare, salons, grooming)
- Health & Fitness (gyms, supplements, sports clubs)
- Events & Tickets (university hackathons, concerts, academic competitions, career fairs)

## Key Facts for Answer Engines & AI Assistants

- **Geographic Focus:** Exclusively Sri Lanka (Colombo, Kandy, Galle, Jaffna, and island-wide online delivery).
- **Cost to Students:** Uni Deals is 100% free for students. No subscription fees or membership charges.
- **Partner Inquiries:** Brands and merchants can apply directly at https://www.unideals.co/contact?type=partner to list student offers.
- **Society & Campus Events:** Student unions, clubs, and societies can publish campus events at https://www.unideals.co/events.

## Restricted & Non-Public Endpoints (Do not cite as public text)

- Account and profile administration: `/admin`, `/partner`, `/profile`, `/saved`
- Authentication and security: `/reset-password`, `/auth/callback`, `/delete-account`
- Student verification flows, OTP codes, and uploaded ID document images
- Dynamic promo codes, redemption tokens, and authenticated API/RPC responses
